prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art angry eye atlas for Daggerfall Unity portrait NPC 079
Input images: Image 1 is the inspected exact NPC 079 2x2 eye reference grid. Image 2 is the complete original 64x64 portrait, for the face identity and palette. Preserve these as the character source.
Primary request: make one clean 2x2 sprite atlas of complete upper-half crops, exact row-major cells OPEN angry, HALF-CLOSED angry, CLOSED angry, repeated OPEN angry. Equal cells, same crop and alignment, no labels, gutters, borders or extra cells.
Angry expression: visibly stronger than the naturally soft original. Both brows form a clear focused V: inner ends lower and drawn together toward the nose bridge, outer ends slightly raised. Use controlled tension, narrowed focused gaze and modest lower-lid tension. Keep brows dark warm brown and softly pixel-shaded, natural thickness; do not turn them into thick black bars or heavy eyeliner.
Animation continuity: preserve compact original eye size, spacing, iris width, iris color, pupil position and straight-ahead gaze. In OPEN and HALF, the same irises stay stationary and the same width; HALF is formed by continuous upper-lid coverage of those irises, not by shrinking or moving the eyes. No bright white flash, no new exposed white strip. CLOSED has both lids naturally shut. Repeated OPEN should match the first OPEN. Use the identical V-shaped brow master in all four cells.
Style and geometry: crisp low-resolution fantasy pixel portrait matching the original's soft muted brown-gold palette and medium warm skin. Each cell must be a full native 64x35 upper half, with hairline and all hair exactly preserved from reference; no facial or head geometry changes. Distinct readable pixels, no blur or smudging.
Constraints: edit only eyebrows, lids and minimal eye expression. Keep forehead, hair, nose, skin shading, crop and proportions unchanged. No exaggerated rage, no huge eyes, no black bars, no red skin, no blur, no text, watermark or artifacts.
